dct_creator_sm: Costanzo, Lucia (McLaughlin Library. University of Guelph., University of Guelph).
dct_description_sm: A list of occurrence data on calls for service in the City of Guelph in the 2016 calendar year was obtained from the Guelph Police Open Data portal. An OpenStreetMap based API was used to generate latitude and longitude coordinates for the occurrence data.
